response.prompt: How many no-questions-asked extensions do I get this quarter, how long is each one, and how am I supposed to request it?

conditions.answer: You get one no-questions-asked extension per quarter. Each one is 7 days long. You can request a no-questions-asked extension by submitting a request through the Canvas course dropbox for the assignment you want to extend.
